title.ar: الفصل 25 — الرجل اللي ورا كل إشي

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: بليلة، إجا هولمز عالبيت ووجهه شاحب.
sentences.en: One night, Holmes came to the house with a pale face.

sentences.ar: قال: سمعت باسم موريارتي من قبل؟
sentences.en: He said: have you heard the name Moriarty before?
He said: and that is his greatness.

sentences.ar: محدا بيعرفه، وهو ورا نص الجرائم بلندن.
sentences.en: Nobody knows him, and he is behind half the crimes in London.

sentences.ar: قال: هو زي عنكبوت بنص شبكة.
sentences.en: He said: he is like a spider in the middle of a web.

sentences.ar: ما بيتحرك، بس بيحس بكل خيط بينهز.
sentences.en: He does not move, but he feels every thread that trembles.

sentences.ar: وهلق، لأول مرة، الشبكة كلها بإيدي.
sentences.en: And now, for the first time, the whole web is in my hand.
